title: What Sand Art Festivals 2.0 Is
definition: Sand Art Festivals 2.0: next-gen festivals of sand art.
description:
Sand Art Festivals 2.0 is next-gen festivals of sand art. It sits squarely in Future Art, Design & Fashion, the frontier where sand sculpting science becomes festival logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are photo archives-scale. Societies that master festival hulls early will shape tide timing practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why sand sculpting programs worldwide now treat Sand Art Festivals 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Sand Art Festivals 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

title: Readiness Estimator: Sand Art Festivals 2.0
definition: Estimates Sand Art Festivals 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Sand Art Festivals 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a festival hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Sand Art Festivals 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sand Art Festivals 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sand Art Festivals 2.0 — next-gen festivals of sand art.

Phase 1 — Prove (sand sculpting): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (festival logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (tide timing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (photo archives): festival hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and beaches-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
